vape_chassis_recycled_matte_asa.structural_purpose: Tactile, sleek exterior electronic enclosure. Sliced at a fine 0.16mm step profile to deliver a smooth, high-end consumer hand feel that matches standard high-end consumer vaporizers without requiring secondary vapor chemical smoothing.

retention_ring_flexible_high_rebound_tpu.structural_purpose: Glue-free mechanical snap retention gasket. Printed out of pure TPU with thick solid perimeters to maximize elastic structural retention memory, enabling the internal snap lock to expand under battery insertion force and clip shut without fracturing.
